items.q: How is LeappBee different from hiring a full-time editor?
items.a: LeappBee gives you instant access to a full post production team, editors, strategists, motion designers, without the overhead of salaries or onboarding time.

items.q: Can I keep using my existing project tools?
items.a: Absolutely. We slot into your existing workflow. Whether you use Notion, Slack, or ClickUp, our team adapts to your system within the first week.

items.q: What happens when a project hits its revision limit?
items.a: We build revision rounds into every project upfront. Further revisions are quoted and approved before any additional work begins, no surprises.

items.q: How do I track what is in production?
items.a: You get a live dashboard showing every asset, its status, and the responsible editor. No chasing, no surprises.

items.q: Do you work continuously or in batches?
items.a: Both. Rolling weekly batches or sprint style runs around launches, whatever suits your calendar and release cadence.

items.q: Why LeappBee instead of a freelancer marketplace?
items.a: Consistency. A marketplace gives you a random editor per project. LeappBee gives you a dedicated team that learns your brand, voice, and audience over time.

items.q: What does a typical retainer look like?
items.a: Most clients start on a monthly plan covering 8–20 long form or 30–60 short form videos, with unlimited minor revisions included.

items.q: Do you accept one off projects?
items.a: Yes. We take one off launches, trailer cuts, and ad campaigns alongside retainer clients. Availability may vary, book a call to confirm.
